name: qualixar-jev-control
description: Selective Jev Policy Mode with a clear one-time Codex hook-trust path.

interface.shortDescription: Selective Jev decisions with trusted local Codex policy hooks.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local Policy Mode plus 20 bounded Jev workflows to Codex. After a one-time review in Codex CLI, assist mode routes relevant Jev judgments automatically; opt-in enforce mode gates governed tools until a matching evaluation succeeds. Live requests still require an expiring human-created grant for the exact workspace.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide whether this task needs a bounded Jev judgment.
Classify the data before any Jev evaluation in this workspace.
Explain the provider and workspace-scoped Jev live-authority gates.
